IPS Officer J.S. Gangwar Appointed BPSSC Chairman

IPS officer J.S. Gangwar has been appointed as the Chairman of the Bihar Public Service Selection Commission (BPSSC). Gangwar's name was also previously considered in the race for the Director General of Police (DGP) position. This appointment follows the departure of K.S. Dwivedi.
